title: Virginia Beach turned 640,000 tons of garbage into a 60-foot hill, now a 165-acre park
summary_full: Mount Trashmore Park in Virginia Beach serves as a unique example of transformation, evolving from a large landfill into a vibrant 165-acre recreational area. Opening its gates in 1973, this park now boasts serene lakes, extensive trails, and playgrounds, showcasing innovative landfill reclamation practices. Its picturesque setting attracts visitors who appreciate the blend of nature and community space, highlighting the benefits of repurposing land.
